name: deploy-kit
description: 把目录或文件部署到 nginx / docker / 其他目标：rsync·scp·ssh 自动兼容，多跳 + 提权，事务性发布

scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:gates
scripts.verify:gates: pnpm run verify:versions && pnpm exec knip && pnpm run verify:coverage && gitleaks detect --no-git --source build --redact --no-banner && node --test tests/smoke.test.mjs
scripts.verify:mutation: node tools/mutate.mjs --package schema --max all --fail-over 5 && node tools/mutate.mjs --package core --max all --fail-over 5 && node tools/mutate.mjs --package template --max all --fail-over 5
scripts.verify:coverage: c8 --clean=false --reporter=none node --test "packages/*/build/**/*.test.js" && c8 report --check-coverage --lines 100 --statements 100 --include "packages/schema/build/**" --exclude "**/*.test.js" --reporter=none && c8 report --check-coverage --lines 100 --statements 100 --include "packages/core/build/**" --exclude "**/*.test.js" --reporter=none && c8 report --check-coverage --lines 100 --statements 100 --include "packages/template/build/**" --exclude "**/*.test.js" --reporter=none
